subject.title: fix(tools): surface empty availability group diagnostics via onHiddenDiagnostic callback

question: Should this PR be accepted as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92361 with warn-only preservation of plugin-authored availability-like metadata?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but the compatibility behavior and overlapping sibling PRs require maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept this warn-only path
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks if maintainers accept that availability-like plugin metadata now feeds warnings without changing returned tool visibility.

options.title: Choose a narrower sibling
options.body: Select an open sibling PR if maintainers prefer a smaller planner-only or registration-only implementation, then close this PR after that path lands.

options.title: Request a different contract
options.body: Ask for a revised patch if malformed plugin availability should filter tools or become an explicit public SDK contract instead of only warning.

recommendation.title: Accept this warn-only path
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks if maintainers accept that availability-like plugin metadata now feeds warnings without changing returned tool visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on plugin descriptor-cache behavior and compatibility, where history points most strongly to steipete.
